alchemySection.title: The Story of Nine Roasting Cycles Inside Bamboo Tubes
paragraphs: Rather than making exaggerated claims about what salt does for the body, Bambaura is defined by the authentic craft of its preparation. Natural salt is packed tightly inside thick mountain bamboo tubes, sealed with yellow mineral clay, and roasted repeatedly over natural pine wood.

Across nine iterative cycles, the intense heat and aromatic bamboo fibers gradually transform the salt's physical structure, giving it its recognisable brownish colour, rounded savory flavor, and distinctive fine texture.

culinarySection.title: An Interesting Addition to Your Kitchen & Table
culinarySection.description: Bambaura 9X brings a unique story and presentation to your cooking. Pinch the fine brownish granules over grilled meats, roasted seasonal greens, eggs, and hearty broths for balanced seasoning without harsh sharpness.
